verdict.rationale: NVIDIA docs confirm 141GB HBM3e at 4.8TB/s per GPU, explicit Llama2 70B inference benchmarks (1.9X faster), and community evidence corroborates real-world deployment of even larger 405B models at high throughput on H200 SXM, demonstrating 70B-class quantized (or full-precision) inference is well within capacity and bandwidth headroom. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmark specifically on a quantized 70B model rather than vendor-reported figures.
